question: A put option is ‘out-of-the-money’ if:

options.A: Its strike price is higher than the current market price of the underlying commodity
options.B: If the current market price of the underlying commodity is higher than the strike price of the option
options.C: Its strike price is equal to the current market price of the underlying commodity
options.D: If the current market price of the underlying commodity is lower than the strike price of the option

community_answer: B. If the current market price of the underlying commodity is higher than the strike price of the option

question: A CD with a face value of EUR 10,000,000.00 and a coupon of 3% was issued at par for 182 days and is now trading at 3.10% with 120 days remaining to maturity. What has been the capital gain or loss since issue?
A “time option” is an outright forward FX transaction where the customer:

options.A: has the option to fulfill the outright forward or not at maturity
options.B: may freely choose the maturity, given a 24-hour notice to the bank
options.C: can choose any maturity within a previously fixed period
options.D: may decide to deal at the regular maturity or on either the business day before or after

community_answer: C. can choose any maturity within a previously fixed period

question: The Market Segmentation hypothesis suggests that the yield curve bends at some point along its length because:

options.A: Investors have less appetite for longer-term investments
options.B: Borrowers prefer to borrow long-term but lenders prefer to lend short-term
options.C: Different types of institution tend to specialize in different maturity ranges
options.D: The risk premium becomes significant only at longer maturities

community_answer: C. Different types of institution tend to specialize in different maturity ranges

question: Which statement about modern matched-maturity transfer pricing in banks is correct?

options.A: It is now a widely accepted standard that banks should use a single representative transfer price across the entire maturity spectrum.
options.B: Modern matched-maturity pricing systems include an additional liquidity surcharge that is specifically applied to more liquid short maturities.
options.C: Matched-maturity transfer prices should represent a weighted average cost of capital that incorporates the cost of equity into the cost of borrowed funds.
options.D: Modern matched-maturity systems differentiate transfer prices by the maturity of the commitment and also apply a marginal funding cost perspective.

community_answer: D. Modern matched-maturity systems differentiate transfer prices by the maturity of the commitment and also apply a marginal funding cost perspective.
